Farm Frenzy: Hurricane Season continues the long-running time management series by giving players another round of frantic farming in a lighthearted package. The setup is straightforward but effective: a hurricane has devastated farmland, and it falls on you to rebuild from scratch by raising animals, producing goods, and restoring the supply chain piece by piece. The story is minimal and mostly serves as a frame for the action, but it does provide enough context to explain why you are constantly upgrading, producing, and racing against the clock to keep your farm alive.

The visual style embraces the cartoonish, colorful charm the series is known for. Animals bounce around with exaggerated animations, produce shines brightly when ready for collection, and the interface uses bold icons to make sure you never lose track of what needs attention. The graphics do not push any boundaries, but they do their job of keeping the screen clear and readable even during chaotic moments. Animations like trucks pulling in for deliveries or predators looming on the screen provide helpful visual cues, adding a layer of polish that makes the experience easier to follow despite its fast pace. Over long play sessions, however, backgrounds and environments can feel repetitive, which undercuts the visual novelty.

The gameplay remains the star of the show, and Hurricane Season doubles down on the series’ signature formula. Every level asks you to juggle raising animals, harvesting resources, and processing goods into more profitable products, all while managing a limited amount of time and money. Early missions start off gently, teaching the basics of collecting eggs or milk, but before long you are juggling multiple production chains, upgrading buildings, and fending off intruding threats like bears or other nuisances. The balance of multitasking and resource prioritization is what makes the game so addictive, and it is where Farm Frenzy continues to shine.

Hurricane Season introduces a few small twists to keep things fresh. One is the addition of tokens that can be used in a slot machine system, offering rewards like boosts or extra resources for those who consistently earn gold medals on levels. It is a light form of meta-progression that encourages replaying levels to perfect them. Collectible stickers and upgrade paths for your farm tools add another layer of motivation, even if the upgrades eventually feel less impactful once the essentials are maxed out. The later stages raise the difficulty enough to challenge even experienced players, with levels demanding careful timing and constant attention to every moving part.

Not everything works perfectly, though. Some players have noted that controls can feel unresponsive at times, with clicks occasionally failing to register. In a game that relies on split-second decisions, even small lapses in input recognition can feel punishing. The soundtrack also becomes repetitive fairly quickly, relying on the same cheerful but looping country-style tracks throughout much of the campaign. While it sets the right mood initially, it loses its charm after hearing it on repeat across dozens of stages. Performance on PC is generally stable, though a handful of users report the occasional crash or hiccup during more hectic moments.

Despite these shortcomings, the game offers a healthy amount of content. There are dozens of levels to complete, each with its own set of objectives and medals to chase. A single run can last several hours, and the pursuit of perfect scores on every level extends the replay value. That said, once most upgrades are unlocked and the sticker collection is complete, long-term replayability is limited unless you particularly enjoy chasing faster times or revisiting levels for efficiency. For many, the game works best in shorter bursts, offering a fun challenge between longer or more demanding titles.

Overall, Farm Frenzy: Hurricane Season is a lively and entertaining entry in the series. It doesn’t radically reinvent the formula, but it refines the familiar loop of time management and resource juggling into a satisfying experience. Its cheerful presentation, escalating challenge, and light progression systems give fans of the genre exactly what they are looking for. While the repetitive music, occasional responsiveness issues, and lack of deep replayability hold it back from being a standout classic, it succeeds as a reliable, energetic farming puzzle that captures the appeal of the Farm Frenzy franchise. For players who enjoy multitasking under pressure and turning chaos into order, this entry is a worthy addition to the collection.

Rating: 8/10

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

Farm Frenzy: Hurricane Season, yıkıcı bir kasırganın ardından çiftliğinizi yeniden inşa etmeye çalışan bir çiftçi olarak oynadığınız heyecan verici bir zaman yönetimi oyunudur. Oyun, her yaştan oyuncuyu memnun edecek parlak ve renkli görsellere sahiptir. Oyun, çiftliğinizi yönetmeyi ve hayvanlarınıza bakmayı kolaylaştıran bir işaretle ve tıkla arayüzü ile basittir.

Oyunda ilerledikçe ürün toplamanız, kasabada satmak için yeni tarifler öğrenmeniz ve çiftliğinizi mallarınızı çalmak isteyen sinir bozucu gelinciklerden korumanız gerekecek. Oyun ayrıca çiftçiliğe ara verip rulet masasında şansınızı deneyebileceğiniz eğlenceli bir bonus özelliği de içeriyor. Oynarken eğlenceli koleksiyon çıkartmaları için gözlerinizi dört açın.

Düzinelerce heyecan verici seviye ile Farm Frenzy: Kasırga Sezonu sizi saatlerce eğlendirecek. Oyun, başlamak için bilmeniz gereken her şeyi öğreten, takip etmesi kolay bir öğretici içerir. Oyunda ilerledikçe, çiftçilik hünerleriniz için ödüller kazanacak ve komik çıkartmalar toplayacaksınız.

Genel olarak, Farm Frenzy: Hurricane Season, zaman yönetimi oyunlarının hayranlarına hitap edeceği kesin olan eğlenceli ve ilgi çekici bir oyundur. Sizi saatlerce eğlendirecek bir oyun arıyorsanız, Farm Frenzy'den başkasına bakmayın: Kasırga Sezonu!

Gelegenheitsspiel mit viel Klickerei. Erinnert mich eher an App-Spiele. Ich persönlich finde es nicht so schön jedes Level "neu" anzufangen, dafür kann man sagen, dass man nach jedem Level entspannt auch wieder aus machen kann, es ist also kein allzu schlimmer Zeitfresser. Es gibt keinen Fortschritt außer neue Level frei zu schalten und anstatt mit Hühnern dann eben mit Schweinen oder Kühen sein Geld zu verdienen. Manche Level sind wirklich knifflig und es kann ein paar Versuche brauchen sie auf Goldniveau zu schaffen. Da muss man schon manchmal seinen Spielstil ändern und an das Level anpassen. Das Slotmaschine System um Boni frei zu schalten finde ich langweilig und langwierig. Man hat irgendwann viel zu viele Coins und könnte da 3 Stunden drehen. Doof, wenn man einen bestimmten Bonus haben möchte, aber generell wird man mit Boni eher überschüttet, als dass man zu kurz kommt. Alles in allem muss man den Spielstil mögen. Wiederspielwert hat es für mich nicht, aber nach 25 Stunden, um alle Erfolge mitzunehmen kann man eigentlich auch nicht meckern. 

Für Kinder, die begrenzte Zeit am Bildschirm verbringen dürfen eine sehr gute Wahl! 

Am besten mal ein Level angucken und selbst entscheiden, ob es einem liegt!
